# capability

The `mandate.escalate` mandate capability as plain data: an agent granted it
may switch its own task to the supervisor mandate with `become_supervisor`
(`tasks/supervisor-run`), when the task's scope turns out too big for one
context. A leaf — `supervisor-run` imports `mandate-presets`, which grants it
(interactive only). The tool and its checks stay in `supervisor-run`.

## Plugin reference

- Description: The mandate.escalate capability as plain data: an agent granted it may switch its own task to the supervisor mandate (become_supervisor). A leaf, so mandate-presets can grant it without a cycle through supervisor-run, which imports mandate-presets.
- Core:
  - Uses: `tasks/orchestration/mandate/policy.defineCapability`
  - Exports (values): `mandateEscalate`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `tasks/mandate-presets`
    - `tasks/supervisor-run`
